controls.title: COSO Principle 1
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

controls.title: COSO Principle 2
controls.description: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 3
controls.description: Management establishes, with board oversight, structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 4
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals in alignment with objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 5
controls.description: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities in the pursuit of objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 13
controls.description: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 14
controls.description: The entity internally communicates information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support the functioning of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 15
controls.description: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 6
controls.description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 7
controls.description: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyzes risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.

controls.title: COSO Principle 8
controls.description: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 9
controls.description: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.

controls.title: COSO Principle 16
controls.description: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.

controls.title: COSO Principle 17
controls.description: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those parties responsible for taking corrective action, including senior management and the board of directors, as appropriate.

controls.title: COSO Principle 10
controls.description: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.

controls.title: COSO Principle 11
controls.description: The entity also selects and develops general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.

controls.title: COSO Principle 12
controls.description: The entity deploys control activities through policies that establish what is expected and in procedures that put policies into action.

controls.title: Security Software, Infrastructure, and Architectures
controls.description: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets.

controls.title: User Registration and Authorization
controls.description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity registers and authorizes new internal and external users.

controls.title: Access Removal
controls.description: The entity removes access to protected information assets when appropriate.

controls.title: Physical Access Restrictions
controls.description: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.

controls.title: Asset Disposal
controls.description: The entity discontinues logical and physical protections over physical assets only after the ability to read or recover data and software from those assets has been diminished.

controls.title: Transmission, Movement, and Removal
controls.description: The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries.

controls.title: Data Encryption
controls.description: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes.

controls.title: Malicious Software Prevention
controls.description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.

controls.title: Vulnerability Detection
controls.description: To meet its objectives, the entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Security Event Monitoring
controls.description: The entity monitors system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors.

controls.title: Security Event Evaluation
controls.description: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure of the entity to meet its objectives.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident response program.

controls.title: Incident Recovery
controls.description: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from identified security incidents.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.

controls.title: Business Disruption Risk Mitigation
controls.description: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk mitigation activities for risks arising from potential business disruptions.

controls.title: Vendor and Business Partner Risk
controls.description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners.

controls.title: Capacity Planning
controls.description: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity and use of system components to manage capacity demand and to enable the implementation of additional capacity to help meet its objectives.

controls.title: Environmental Protections
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, implements, operates, approves, maintains, and monitors environmental protections, software, data backup processes, and recovery infrastructure.

controls.title: Recovery Testing
controls.description: The entity tests recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery to meet its objectives.

controls.title: Processing Accuracy and Completeness
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system processing to result in products, services, and reporting to meet the entity's specifications.

controls.title: Input Validation
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system inputs, including controls over completeness and accuracy, to result in products, services, and reporting to meet the entity's specifications.

controls.title: Processing Validation
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures over system processing, including the design and use of processing logic and calculations, to result in products, services, and reporting to meet the entity's specifications.

controls.title: Output Review
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures to make available or deliver output completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with specifications to meet the entity's objectives.

controls.title: Data Stores
controls.description: The entity implements policies and procedures to store inputs, items in processing, and outputs completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with system specifications.

controls.title: Confidential Information Identification
controls.description: The entity identifies and maintains confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.

controls.title: Confidential Information Disposal
controls.description: The entity disposes of confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.

controls.title: Confidential Information Protection
controls.description: The entity maintains confidentiality of information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.

controls.title: Privacy Notice
controls.description: The entity provides notice to data subjects about its privacy practices.

controls.title: Choice and Consent
controls.description: The entity communicates choices available regarding the collection, use, retention, disclosure, and disposal of personal information.

controls.title: Collection Limitation
controls.description: Personal information is collected consistent with the entity's objectives related to privacy.

controls.title: Explicit Consent
controls.description: For information requiring explicit consent, the entity communicates the need for such consent.

controls.title: Use Limitation
controls.description: The entity limits the use of personal information to the purposes identified in the entity's objectives related to privacy.

controls.title: Retention Limitation
controls.description: The entity retains personal information consistent with the entity's objectives related to privacy.

controls.title: Disposal
controls.description: The entity securely disposes of personal information to meet the entity's objectives related to privacy.

controls.title: Access
controls.description: The entity grants identified and authenticated data subjects the ability to access their stored personal information.

controls.title: Correction
controls.description: The entity corrects, amends, or appends personal information based on information provided by data subjects.

controls.title: Disclosure to Third Parties
controls.description: The entity discloses personal information to third parties with the explicit consent of data subjects.

controls.title: Third Party Notification
controls.description: The entity creates and retains a complete, accurate, and timely record of authorized disclosures of personal information.

controls.title: Inquiry Management
controls.description: The entity creates and retains a complete, accurate, and timely record of detected or reported unauthorized disclosures of personal information.

controls.title: Third Party Privacy Practices
controls.description: The entity obtains privacy commitments from vendors and other third parties who have access to personal information.

controls.title: Breach Notification
controls.description: The entity obtains commitments from vendors and other third parties with access to personal information to notify the entity in the event of breaches.

controls.title: Third Party Assessment
controls.description: The entity provides for and performs privacy compliance assessment procedures for vendors and other third parties who have access to personal information.

controls.title: Cross Border Transfers
controls.description: The entity collects and maintains explicit consent for the transfer of personal information to or from an identified country.

controls.title: Data Quality
controls.description: The entity collects and maintains accurate, up-to-date, complete, and relevant personal information to meet the entity's objectives.

controls.title: Complaint Management
controls.description: The entity implements a process for receiving, addressing, resolving, and communicating the resolution of inquiries, complaints, and disputes from data subjects.

controls.title: Dispute Resolution
controls.description: The entity documents and communicates to data subjects information about its complaint management process.
